verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that `brew info` has a `--json` mode: the Formulae API docs describe their endpoints as listing the `brew info --json` output. That is a first-party, machine-readable output path from one core CLI command. Beyond that one command, nothing in the pack documents JSON output for other core commands. The hosted JSON data API is a web endpoint, not CLI output, so it does not count here. missing for 10: documented `--json` flags on other core commands (list, outdated, search, install/upgrade results), first-party manpage documentation of the JSON output format, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent parsing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text

citations.quote: List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
